_doc: Recorded drum kits for the iPhone LoopStar (2026-10-23). Listed only for accounts on a subscriber tier (Creator, Pro, Admin) unless a kit says "access": "free". Each kit is ONE file on our download bucket (url), fetched the first time a subscriber picks it, checked against sha256, then kept on the device: every voice back to back in a mono 48 kHz 16-bit WAV, 0.1 s apart. Per kit: id (never reuse one), name, group (the chooser's heading), blurb, credit (who recorded it and the licence: CC0 or CC-BY only, since the samples themselves are redistributed), fallback (the synth kit id that plays wherever the samples aren't: another device, the Mac, an account that isn't entitled, before the download), url, sha256, bytes, slices (LoopStarDrumVoice raw value -> [first frame, frames] in the file: kick, snare, clap, closedHat, openHat, rim, tom, shaker, ride, crash; a voice left out is played by the fallback synth), gains (per-voice balance, default 1). Built and uploaded by drums/tools/build_sample_kits.py from drums/sample-kits.config.json; the app's bundled copy (loopstar_sample_kits_fallback.json) must equal this file.

kits.name: Big Room Rock
kits.blurb: A big vintage kit, close mics with the overheads: an open 24-inch kick, a cracking snare, a washy ride.
kits.credit: Big Rusty Drums by Karoryfer Samples (CC0 1.0); shaker Virtuosity Drums by Versilian Studios & Karoryfer Samples (CC0 1.0); clap VCSL by Versilian Studios (CC0 1.0)

kits.name: Studio Club
kits.blurb: A tight club kit through one ribbon mic: dry, round, a little room. Funk, soul, indie.
kits.credit: Virtuosity Drums by Versilian Studios & Karoryfer Samples (CC0 1.0); clap VCSL by Versilian Studios (CC0 1.0)

kits.name: Dusty Vintage
kits.blurb: A jazz kit through a 1950s mic, pitched down and crunched to 12 bits: boom-bap dust.
kits.credit: Virtuosity Drums by Versilian Studios & Karoryfer Samples (CC0 1.0); clap VCSL by Versilian Studios (CC0 1.0)

kits.name: Crunchy Knock
kits.blurb: A big kit's close mics, pitched down and driven through a 12-bit sampler: hard knocks for a head-nod.
kits.credit: Big Rusty Drums by Karoryfer Samples (CC0 1.0); tambourine Virtuosity Drums by Versilian Studios & Karoryfer Samples (CC0 1.0); clap VCSL by Versilian Studios (CC0 1.0)
